name: conservation_1to1
informal: totalShares == totalAssets — no value minted from air
notes: CHC proved 3 VCs safe (deposit, withdraw, check). Vacuity confirmed: mutated assert(totalShares != totalAssets) produces counterexample.

name: solvency_price_geq_1
informal: totalAssets >= totalShares — every share backed by >= 1 asset unit
notes: CHC proved 3 VCs safe. Vacuity confirmed: mutated assert(totalAssets < totalShares) produces counterexample.

name: no_orphan_shares
informal: totalShares == 0 <=> totalAssets == 0 — no shares without backing and vice versa
notes: CHC proved 3 VCs safe. Vacuity confirmed: mutated assert with != produces counterexample.
